description: Use this for whether someone qualifies for a government home buying scheme: shared ownership, First Homes, Your First Home, Deposit Unlock, Lifetime ISA, the Mortgage Guarantee Scheme, Rent to Buy, Own New and the closed Help to Buy equity loan. Each scheme comes back likely eligible, possibly eligible (local rules unconfirmed) or not eligible, with the rule that decided it, its source, and the facts still needed. With no facts, it lists every scheme and whether it is open.

home.description: A home page address from a search: its price, nation and builder offers are used.

lifetime_isa_first_payment.description: The date of the first payment into a Lifetime ISA, if one is held.

nation.description: Where the home is. Scotland pays LBTT and Wales LTT; England and Northern Ireland stamp duty.
